slides.text: Nvidia said Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO, effective immediately, with finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO while the board looks for a permanent one.
Anthropic, the company behind Claude, started pitching its planned stock market debut to investors: 825 million shares at an expected $70 to $78 each, with a planned Nasdaq listing.

Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, which it calls its strongest model, for paying developers and Ultra subscribers, then Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster model that free users get through automatic model selection.
OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for US Pro users, so its AI agents can pay without seeing the real card number, and the user approves each purchase.
Apple launched a US research app to study how people use AI for health, aiming for up to 200,000 iPhone users in a study lasting more than a year.
